intelligence_path: Stochastic input provides varied experiment parameters
The isolated environment supplies observable consequences

limitations: A generated task is a synthetic environment, not a hidden message extracted from noise
The rule vocabulary is finite and predefined; inference selects its parameters from examples
Source-seeded experimental variety is not physical zero-point sensing
Prediction scores across different target representations do not establish a transformation improves original-source forecasting
Planning currently operates in the registered byte-operation vocabulary; it does not establish general-purpose reasoning or physical zero-point access
The hydrogen/star/Earth reservoir labels denote simulated memory stages, not measured physical processes
Feature-map prediction gains are task-specific and do not establish a physical origin of intelligence
Equation discovery currently searches a finite power-law family and idealised simulated reference models, not arbitrary scientific laws
Correctly rediscovering a coded reference equation is not independent physical evidence for the model or for zero-point intelligence
